name: Art Deco
visualIdentity: Supplemental reference, not a style directly named in the source collection. Uses axial symmetry, stepped silhouettes, sunbursts, repeated geometric ornament and precise geometric display type. Metallic accents are restrained, with masked highlight sweeps rather than indiscriminate gold effects.
suitableUses: Explicitly suits ornament-led titles and posters. Suggested hybrids support hotel, theater or gala openers, period title sequences, invitations, menus, product launches and premium landing pages. Inferred suitability: explanatory or editorial stories with concise copy and clear focal points.
limitations: Ornament must not compete with body text. Avoid repeated gold shimmer, blur, sparkle, pastel film grading and asymmetric handheld moves in the suggested combinations. Short topics may not need chapter transitions; omit or adapt transitions that obscure causality, break a continuous shot or loop, hide copy, or conflict with style materials and motion.
palette: Suggested fallback tokens for new artwork only: background #151515, foreground #F6EEDC, accent #B99A57. Use discrete colors; gradients are disabled in this proposal. Preserve task, brand, reference and existing semantic colors and asset colors exactly. Keep accent subordinate except where bold geometric fields suit the style. Check contrast in composed frames; listed ratios do not ensure readability over textures, transparency, video or lighting.
motionAndInteraction: Reveal layers, draw forms toward center and use controlled highlight sweeps. Suggested video motions are measured axial push-ins and symmetric reveals, or chapter/story states with readable holds. For interactive HTML, finite scroll progress may control chapter handoffs or narrative states; reverse scrolling should restore them deterministically. Reduced-motion and static states are advised by the interaction patterns. Video must use composition time, not live input; direct and backward seeking must reproduce state.
audio: Unspecified as a fixed style rule. Choose music, voiceover, vocals, effects, ambience or silence for the topic and audience, honoring supplied assets and explicit requirements. Keep speech clear, avoid clipping and competing vocals, and synchronize and inspect audio with picture.
assetRequirements: Build symmetric paths and repeated ornaments, with carefully chosen display and text faces; use SVG for scalable shapes, strokes, masks and clipping. Metallic appearance may be simulated with restrained gradients and masked highlights, but palette gradient permission is disabled, so do not assume gradients are allowed by that palette proposal. Load fonts and assets locally; preserve supplied artwork and exact colors.
combinations: Art Deco alone suits ornament-led titles and posters. With style-104, keep camera moves axial and gold limited to ornament and one sweep; center geometric type. With style-020, use generous copy spacing, frame rather than underlay body text, use one display and one text face, retain the Deco palette and omit taupe. Motion references 012 (chapter handoff) and 015 (story progression) are optional and scene-dependent; select none if unsupported.
productionApproach: Select SVG or another style renderer and one motion owner based on scene needs; GSAP is recommended for paused, seekable timelines, Motion is optional and needs verified synchronization. HyperFrames is the default composition/export pipeline; Remotion only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required capability, with reason recorded. Pipeline handles assembly, timing, media/audio sync, validation and export, not visual design. Use deterministic composition time, inspect key frames and full output, and verify dimensions, duration, frame rate, sync and loop continuity.
